title: 1712 Prairie's roof is lowered to its 1893 drawing
items: The roof of 1712 Prairie Avenue is now a low hip at 18 degrees, as the 1893 Rand McNally view of the street draws it. It was 25 degrees, which stood about 2 m too tall in the comparison with the drawing.
The house now matches its one known picture, and its chimney stands lower with the roof.
